## Quick summary

This repository contains a Rust workspace (calendar generation + backend) and a Vue 3 + Vite frontend. Focus areas for AI coding agents:

- Backend: `liturgy-backend/` — HTTP API server, calendar caching logic, and static-file serving of the frontend `dist/`.
- Calendar data: `calendar_calc/calendar_data/*.toml` — canonical source of liturgical calendar definitions.
- Frontend: `liturgy-frontend/` — Vite + Vue 3 TypeScript SPA.
